title: MWS 3-year resurvey — Behavioral
description: Diet, alcohol, and smoking behaviors reported at the 3-year resurvey.

F1FQORGN.title: Frequency of eating organic food
F1FQORGN.$comment: Source's own code list includes -1=Not on questionnaire for this field (not available on the 9903/9907 versions, available on 9909/0012) -- kept as the source-documented sentinel, same unenforced treatment as recruitment's REXANY (D020/D021): no skip pair added against F1QTYPE, the field's own -1 code covers it.

F15YDIET.title: Major diet changes in the last 5 years
F15YDIET.$comment: Available on every questionnaire version -- no not_on_questionnaire sentinel needed, generic null fallback per D020.

F1ALCNUM.title: Alcoholic drinks per week
F1ALCNUM.$comment: Steward confirmed: non-drinkers were instructed to answer 0, so no skip rule applies -- 0 is a real, substantive value, not a sentinel (Q30's own 'put 0 if you do not drink' instruction, verified against mws-Q3.pdf, D103). Bound removed entirely -- the earlier agent-decided/derived plausibility bound was retired per Montse's dictionary-fidelity requirement (D101-D104). 97 and 99 are the source's own two distinct 'unknown' codes (kept as their own const branches, not merged into null, same treatment as F1MENOAG's 77/99 -- D051); field converted oneOf->anyOf since the now-unbounded numeric branch would otherwise overlap them (D101).

F1ALCEAT.title: Drinks alcohol with meals
F1ALCEAT.$comment: Steward confirmed this field is not skipped for non-drinkers (F1ALCNUM=0) in the real questionnaire, despite there being no explicit instruction either way -- some non-drinking participants may have left it blank on their own judgment, but nothing in the source documents a structural not-applicable case, so no skip rule is added and no null branch is included. Any gap here is generic null.

F1ALCDAY.title: Number of drinking days per week
F1ALCDAY.$comment: Bound removed entirely -- the earlier agent-decided/derived plausibility bound was retired per Montse's dictionary-fidelity requirement (D101-D104) (the field's own 'per week' framing was never a stated D/E bound, only a structural implication, which does not survive the stricter dictionary-fidelity rule -- D101). Steward confirmed this field is not skipped for non-drinkers -- no null branch, same as F1ALCEAT.

F1DRTEA.title: Tea consumption
F1DRTEA.$comment: Bound removed entirely -- the earlier agent-decided/derived plausibility bound was retired per Montse's dictionary-fidelity requirement (D101-D104). 97 and 99 are the source's own two distinct 'unknown' codes (kept as their own const branches); field converted oneOf->anyOf since the now-unbounded numeric branch would otherwise overlap them (D101).

F1DRCOF.title: Coffee consumption
F1DRCOF.$comment: Same structure and reasoning as F1DRTEA. Bound removed entirely -- source states no range for this field; the earlier agent-decided/derived plausibility bound was retired per Montse's dictionary-fidelity requirement (D101-D104).

F1CIGSPD.title: Cigarettes per day
F1CIGSPD.x-universe: Participants who have ever smoked (F1SMOKE=2 Past or 3 Current) -- someone who has never smoked skips this and any other smoking-related follow-up questions.
F1CIGSPD.$comment: Corrects D060 (superseded): the real questionnaire's actual smoking-status question is 'have you ever been a smoker?' -- a Never answer skips this and subsequent smoking questions entirely, so this IS a real skip pattern, unlike recruitment's RCIGSPD/RSMOKE pair (D035 doesn't transplant here). Steward confirmed '1=None' stays as a real, untouched answer option for Past/Current smokers who report smoking zero on average -- not remapped to null. null branch enforced by a mother-file skip pair keyed on F1SMOKE -- D062.

F1SMOKE.title: Smoking status
F1SMOKE.$comment: Source marks this field 'Derived' for every questionnaire version. 3-level code list, distinct from recruitment's 4-level RSMOKE (which also had a separate 'Not current' level). Real skip pattern against F1CIGSPD -- D062 (corrects D060, which wrongly transplanted recruitment's D035 no-skip reasoning onto this field pair).
